verses.1: For when you go out to fight your enemies, and you see horses and chariots with many people behind them, do not be afraid of them. For Jehovah your God will be with you, helping you to overcome from the land of Egypt.
verses.2: And it shall be like when you are near the battlefield. Then the priest shall go forward and speak to the people.
verses.3: And he said to them, “Listen, Israel! Today you are ready to go to war against your enemies. Do not be afraid or tremble. Do not despise or hate them.”
verses.4: For Jehovah your God will go with you in battle against your enemies, so that He can save you.
verses.5: And the soldiers said to the people, “Who is the man who built a new house but did not furnish it with furniture? He must not go back to his house, for he will die in the war. Another man will be able to furnish it for him.”
verses.6: And the man who planted the vineyard, and did not guard it, will go away and return to his house. Otherwise, he will die in the war, and another man will destroy it.
verses.7: And the man who had taken a woman by force, but did not marry her, should go back to his own house. Otherwise, he might die in the war, and another man would take her away.
verses.8: And the priests spoke to the people, saying, “Who is this man who is wise and kind-hearted? He will go back to his house, and he will not take away the hearts of his brothers like he did before.”
verses.9: And they would speak to the people, just as the priests spoke to the people. The rulers of the armies also presided over the affairs of the people.
verses.10: When you approach a city to fight against it, and you call out to it for help.
verses.11: And if Shelam will answer you and open its doors for you, then all the people who live there will become your slaves and serve you.
verses.12: And if she does not give you what you ask for, and if she goes to war against you, then you will suffer as a result.
verses.13: And Jehovah your God gave it into your hands; and you took away all its memories according to the commandment.
verses.14: Only the women, the cattle, and everything that is in the city—all its possessions—will belong to you. You shall eat up all your enemies’ possessions, for that is what Yahweh, your God, has given you.
verses.15: So, you shall do the same for all those cities that are far from you. These are not the cities of those lands here.
verses.16: Only from the cities of these nations, which Jehovah your God gives you as a inheritance, will no one survive.
verses.17: For the Hittites, Amorites, Canaanites, Perizzites, Hivvites, and Jebusites will be punished, as Jehovah your God commands.
verses.18: So that they may not teach you to do all their wrongs, the things they did to their gods, and their sins against your God.
verses.19: For you are to go into a city that is far away, in order to fight against it. Do not destroy its plans or its plans for your future. Do not plant a cross over there, because from there you will eat. And do not sell it, for man is like a vine that grows from your side in the garden.
verses.20: Only those trees that you know are not trees will be destroyed. I will build a city on the ground where they were built, along with you, during the war until it was destroyed.
